sprawy.listsTitle: Requests for a place in the event list
sprawy.nothing: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
sprawy.opKeyFailed: Could not load the operator key.
sprawy.unlockWhy: Reports are encrypted for the operator role — you open them and sign the decision with its key.
sprawy.noOpKey: This browser doesn't have the operator role's key — only the account that runs it opens and decides reports.
sprawy.askDeleteBody: It will disappear irreversibly — it can't be restored. The decision will be signed with the operator role's key and added to the chain.
sprawy.moved: The chain has moved — the list is refreshed, make the decision again.
sprawy.letterGone: The report's text was deleted half a year after the decision — what was reported and how it was decided remains.
sprawy.reasonLabel: Reason for the decision (the author will see it)
sprawy.signedNote: The operator role's key signs the decision; it goes into a chain that can't be changed quietly.

chainOkLast.other: Chain in order: {count} entries checked (the last {last} of {total}).

sprawy.noPersonal: The card contains no personal data (names, photos of people, private contacts).
sprawy.consentNote: The consent applies to the card in this form — when someone changes it, it disappears from the catalogue until consent is given again.
sprawy.takedowns: Your content blocked after a report
sprawy.operatorDeleted: The operator deleted this content forever.
sprawy.objectionSentAt: Objection sent {date} — the operator will read it and decide: restore the content or delete it forever.
sprawy.objectUntil: Until {date} the content stays blocked but not deleted — during this time you can object. The operator reads the objection before deciding; without an objection they may then delete it forever.
